content.text: Kenyan digital creators, struggling to navigate Stripe's 'availability' in Kenya, have lost up to 90% of transactions on platforms like Gumroad. Not only does this cut into revenue, but also, platforms like Gumroad have complete control over your store, data, and payments. No wonder more creators are turning to sovereign commerce infrastructure to keep their digital businesses afloat. Today, we'll show you how to deploy a reliable ebook sales solution that accepts Bitcoin and stays in your hands. With infrastructure sovereignty, you can be in control, no matter the platform's whims. Here's how to get started.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Gumroad have their limits. They can freeze your account, cancel your transaction, or even steal your customer data. But with sovereign commerce infrastructure, the creator is in charge. You own your store, your data, and your payments. This means you can avoid the risks associated with platforms that come and go, and instead, focus on growing your business without the constant stress of platform unpredictability. With infrastructure sovereignty, you can choose your tools, your payment methods, and your delivery channels, giving you complete control over your digital sales.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy a reliable ebook sales solution, you'll need a few essential tools. First, you'll need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, you'll need a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You'll also need a database like Supabase or Google Sheets to store your orders. Finally, you'll need a payment gateway like NOWPayments that accepts Bitcoin and integrates with your chosen tools. Don't worry if this seems like a lot – we'll walk you through each step, from setup to deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen tools. This will allow you to accept Bitcoin payments and automatically deliver your ebooks to customers. You'll also need to set up a payment method like BSC, Solana, or TRON to minimize transaction fees. Once you've integrated your tools, test your pipeline to ensure that payments are processing correctly and ebooks are being delivered to customers. Don't be afraid to experiment and optimize your pipeline until it's running smoothly.
With sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can accept Bitcoin payments and deliver ebooks to customers without sacrificing infrastructure reliability.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your pipeline is set up and tested, it's time to go live. This means making your ebook sales solution available to your customers and processing your first transaction. To do this, simply point your customers to your ebook sales page and wait for their orders to come in. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically process the payment and deliver the ebook to the customer. After the transaction is complete, you'll receive the payment in your chosen cryptocurrency and can then convert it to USD for your records.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your ebook sales solution is live and processing transactions, it's time to think about scaling. This means growing your business and increasing your revenue without sacrificing infrastructure reliability. To scale your ebook sales solution, start by optimizing your pipeline for performance and security. This might involve upgrading your hosting platform, integrating additional tools, or implementing more advanced payment methods. By scaling your infrastructure and expanding your product line, you can increase your revenue and take your business to new heights.
